Declares the ml schema tables written by Python (counterfactuals, IRFs, forecasts...) as dbt sources.
Fails for every key combination that appears more than once.
Fails for non-null values outside [min_value, max_value].
The "Before" label must be exactly calendar 2024.
Net customs receipts must equal gross minus refunds (within $1m rounding).
Guard against a silently stale ingest: key facts must reach recent periods.
The calendar must have no gaps.
Event-window base date must precede the window end date, and base close must be positive.
ML prediction intervals must nest: lo95 <= lo80 <= point <= hi80 <= hi95.
Exactly one best model per trade series and metric.
Iran-war phases may only start on/after the war start date (28 Feb 2026).
Annualised volatility can never be negative.
A country's headline tariff schedule rows must not overlap in time.
Balance = exports - imports; total trade = exports + imports.
Partner-group import shares (excluding the all-partners total) sum to ~100% each month.

Front-loading ahead of tariffs: Jan-Mar 2025 imports vs Jan-Mar 2024, then Apr-Jun 2025 hangover.
Statutory (2024-import-weighted headline) tariff vs the effective rate actually collected (customs gross & net / imports).
Customs duties: gross, refunds (post-SCOTUS IEEPA refunds), net, YoY and the US-wide effective tariff rate.
Incremental tariff revenue vs the 2024 run-rate, converted to $ per US household (132.2m), cumulative.

Household prices: tariff-exposed goods vs domestic services inflation (YoY) and the gap, by month.

Average YoY inflation by CPI exposure group and tariff/war phase (household lens).
Household squeeze: wages vs prices (real wage YoY), sentiment, saving rate, unemployment, 2024 onward.
Lead-lag: correlation of import-price (ex fuel) YoY with core-goods CPI YoY k months later (k = 0..9), 2017+.
Brent & WTI by Iran-war phase: average, peak and change vs the pre-war close (27 Feb 2026).
Brent since 2025: running peak (window max), drawdown from peak, and the 10 biggest single-day moves.
Strait of Hormuz daily transits (all ships / tankers) by war phase vs the 2024 average (IMF PortWatch).
Which global chokepoints changed most: last 30 days vs pre-war average transits (RANK by disruption).
Pump-price pass-through: regression slope of US gasoline ($/gal) on Brent ($/bbl), monthly, by period.
Event study: cumulative returns of each instrument after the Iran-war start (W02), D0..D+20.

Rolling 63-trading-day correlation of S&P 500 and Brent daily log returns (window aggregate), month-end values.
Fear gauge by phase: VIX average/peak and share of days in stress (>25) or panic (>30) regimes.
Cross-asset scorecard: compounded return of each instrument within each Iran-war phase (exp(sum(log_ret))).
India lens: US-India trade, tariff rate, INR and Nifty by month (2024 onward).
Dollar story: FX moves since 1 Jan 2025 (USD-base pairs: >100 = USD stronger) and since the pre-war close.
